scripts.build: pnpm --filter @agentsync/template build && pnpm --filter @agentsync/contract build && pnpm --filter @agentsync/web build && pnpm --filter agentsync build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @agentsync/template build && pnpm --filter @agentsync/contract build && pnpm -r typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @agentsync/template build && pnpm --filter @agentsync/contract build && pnpm --filter @agentsync/template test && pnpm --filter @agentsync/web test && pnpm --filter agentsync test
